notes.title: The Early Version of Active Matter Is Live!
notes.content: [previewyoutube="DyrkY7dprNk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Operatives, prepare to shatter the boundaries of possibility with Active Matter, a hardcore online shooter featuring realistic weapons in a mind-bending multiverse.[/p][p][url="https://activematter.game/en" style="button" buttoncolor="#f08000"]FIND OUT HOW[/url][/p][p]Participate in dozens of PvPvE and PvE raids solo or in a squad of up to three players across locations ranging from the Soviet-vibe Dalniy Island to exotic Africa. Face off against hostile multiverse creatures corrupted by active matter and against other players who’d love to snatch your loot.[/p][p]Engage in team-based PvP battles in the Nexus on standalone maps, from Aztec temples to futuristic skyscrapers. For these missions, the Agency issues special gear that you keep — even if you fall in battle.[/p][p]Wield over 60 types of firearms — from the Makarov pistol to the M110A1 sniper rifle and a machine gun — and customize your loadout to suit your playstyle. Prefer to stay in the shadow? Take up melee weapons, be it knives, hammers, axes, and even spears to eliminate targets silently.[/p][p]Leverage all the tools of modern warfare by sending drones on recon missions instead of charging head-on into enemy positions.[/p][p]Track and exploit dangerous anomalies from gravity-warping zones that let you traverse vertical surfaces and ceilings, to destructive ball lightning that obliterates everything in its path. Turn these anomalies to your advantage by running across ceilings to flank unsuspecting foes.[/p][p]Upgrade your gear, craft enhancements, and unlock new base features after each raid using the active matter you recover.[/p][p]Ram enemy squads or break pursuit by speeding toward the extraction point in trucks, buggies, ATVs, armored cars, and even tanks.[/p][p]Temporarily team up with other players to challenge giant bosses that demand dozens of operatives and hundreds of rounds to defeat. The stakes are high, but the rewards are immense.[/p][p]The multiverse awaits those bold enough to challenge it and daring enough to escape its deadly loop.[/p]

notes.title: Our Future Plans for Active Matter
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/4b342e1eaa166e73651ae78513f8c37722757adc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The multiverse is awakening - but this is just the beginning! Before the Early Version launch, we ran several Closed Beta Tests - you may even have participated in them. Here’s what we’ve added to the Early Version build compared to the CBT version:[/p][h3][b] New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Isolated PvE raids, where players face only anomalies, not other players[/p][/*][*][p]ATV [/p][/*][*][p]New weapon attachments[/p][/*][*][p]Functional bipods for certain weapon types[/p][/*][*][p]Robo-dog for automated cargo transport[/p][/*][*][p]Realistic scope optics (magnification only visible when aiming)[/p][/*][*][p]Backpacks and medical supplies are now included in the orbital supply drop[/p][/*][*][p]Miss Second can now can scan locations and share useful data.[/p][/*][*][p]New monster: Poltergeist[/p][/*][*][p]Replicator queue system [/p][/*][/list][h3][b] Nexus Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a tutorial for new players[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of loadout presets[/p][/*][*][p]“Epic” presets now unlock once you reach the required score[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced special contracts[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Nexus AI – bots select capture points more strategically, no longer shoot through walls, and avoid blindly chasing players[/p][/*][*][p]Updated English and Russian localization for all Nexus raids[/p][/*][/list][p]Today, we also want to give you a glimpse of what we’re working on. This isn’t the final list - we may add some exciting features beyond what’s outlined here, or re-prioritize our roadmap - but these are what our development team is currently working on. Of course, we’re listening closely to your feedback and taking it into account every step of the way.[/p][h2][b]Planned additions for the Early Version of Active Matter[/b][/h2][h3][b] Battle for Nexus[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The ability to create and join Factions and Syndicates (alliances of players fighting for the Nexus)[/p][/*][*][p]Building and defending a Faction’s base[/p][/*][*][p]Custom contracts[/p][/*][*][p]Large-scale PvP-battles featuring vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Helicopters and jetpacks[/p][/*][*][p]More agency “Body Sleeves”[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Features and Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Chronogenes with skill trees[/p][/*][*][p]New “Miss Second” functionality (additional features and character-related events)[/p][/*][*][p]More supported languages (voiceover and text): Chinese, Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded weapons and customization options[/p][/*][*][p]New defense system: armor classes and bullet penetration ratings [/p][/*][*][p]New vehicles: motorcycles and tricycles[/p][/*][*][p]New anomalies (and upgrades to existing ones): Fire Anomaly, Fireflower pheromones, Raid bosses, more Mimic variants[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controllable monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced gamepad support[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh Raids and locations[/p][/*][/list][p] Please be sure to share your feedback on social media and tell us which changes you’d like to see more of. This will help us focus on what matters most to you![/p]

notes.title: Results of the Fourth Closed Beta Test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/472245cc1affee012d2479ce75a24a9c1bd739d2.jpg[/img]
From June 6th to June 15th, the fourth phase of the Active Matter Closed Beta Test blasted onto the scene - and you set those leaderboards on fire. In just 10 days, players went on more than 58,000 raids, and nearly half - 27,000 - made it out alive. That’s an incredible feat, especially with threats lurking around every corner of the Multiverse.

Along the way, you crushed 48,000 tasks and took down nearly 20,000 fellow Operatives. To put that in perspective, that’s four times the size of Gondor’s army defending Minas Tirith in The Lord of the Rings!

Shout-out to our MVOs (Most Valuable Operatives): one record-holder embarked on a whopping 247 raids — twice as many as last Test’s leader - while another Operative escaped the raid zone alive an incredible 123 times!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/9cde0885a91d74fa20902ec594d4b215bbb34a08.jpg[/img]
But wait - there’s more. In this Beta, players didn’t just tackle raids; they also dove into 9,300 heart-pounding PvP battles on the brand-new Mir and Itsal Kutan maps in the Nexus. No doubt those head-to-head clashes kept you on the edge of your seat!
[previewyoutube=nrG1znOYBTI;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks to everyone who suited up and took part in the fourth Active Matter Closed Beta. Don’t forget to share your feedback - our developers use it to fuel the game’s future improvements!
Sign up on the game’s website and stay tuned for updates. We’ll see you in the Multiverse!

The fourth Closed Beta Test of Active Matter is live! This time, players get the chance to jump into exclusive PvP-only game modes. Here’s what you need to know.
Want in on the next Beta Test? Register your interest on our website — if you’re selected, you’ll receive an invitation directly to your email!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/acb273a2b0a449a33797d8ba8a05d2e16aedc175.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/47364e2fe6e2be2493ed5265489352003f093e2b.jpg[/img]

In this Beta Test phase, world-conquest progression and large-scale vehicle battles are reserved for Raids and future Syndicate battles — only short, but tactical, battles between teams will take place on the fast-paced, compact map Mir Factory. 

Starting June 10th, three new PvP game modes will be introduced in the Nexus, where two teams of Operatives face off on an intense, dynamic map. Here, tactical strategy and individual skill will decide who comes out on top.

notes.title: A Guest from the Future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/6d08399e3c9885e8459e382305d6cd992e1890e4.jpg[/img]
The Steyr AUG assault rifle was a huge breakthrough when it was introduced in 1977. Thanks to its innovative bullpup design and polymer housing, it looked like a weapon from the future compared to other rifles of its time.

Despite the fact that the AUG’s design is still debated among experts, in practice, the rifle proved to be very effective. Originally created for the Austrian Armed Forces, it quickly gained recognition and was adopted by more than 30 countries.

Even after half a century, the Steyr AUG remains one of the most advanced and effective assault rifles. Its secret lies in a unique combination of outstanding precision, exceptional reliability and excellent ergonomics. The AUG shows us that the boldest innovations can become new standards of quality and performance.

You’ll be able to try out the Steyr AUG in Active Matter too. Follow us on social media and register on our website to be among the first to play the game.

notes.title: Small but Mighty
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/da5d6013e9b65400b2113604f365a581fb0ba307.jpg[/img]
In the multiverse of Active Matter, alongside widely used military-grade and rare collectible weapons, you’ll also find gear designed for law enforcement, tank crews, and chemical troops.

The PM-63 is a Polish submachine gun developed in the early '60s by designers Piotr Wilniewczyc and Ryszard Chełmicki. It was officially adopted by the Polish armed forces 1965 and later exported to other Warsaw Pact countries. For example, it became a popular weapon among the Volkspolizei in the German Democratic Republic.

The PM-63 is known for its exceptional compactness, featuring a retractable shoulder stock and a folding front grip. Combined with its high rate of fire, it’s an ideal choice for close-quarters combat and short-range encounters.

You’ll be able to experience the PM-63’s power for yourself during the upcoming closed beta test in the second half of May. Follow us on social media and register on our website so you don’t miss your chance to be among the first to play Active Matter.

notes.title: The Weapon for Those Who Prefer to Stay in the Shadows
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/37488fade5a6b173e96a1dbdf61e13d71d8f9c63.jpg[/img]
The Agency equips its Operatives not only with machine guns and long-range sniper rifles, but also with weapons tailored for those who prefer to eliminate targets quietly. The Hunting Crossbow is one such choice.
Originally invented in the 4th–5th centuries as a stationary weapon, the crossbow only became portable much later. In medieval Europe, it rose to prominence thanks to its power and simplicity.
The Hunting Crossbow in Active Matter is far cry from its historical predecessors. It features an ergonomic stock and a rail mounting system that supports both optical and reflex sights - dramatically improving handling, especially in situations that demand speed and precision.
You’ll have the chance to test the Hunting Crossbow during the upcoming closed beta in the second half of May. Follow us on social media and register on our website for a chance to be among the first to try Active Matter.

notes.title: One Shot – One Kill
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/1f1957d4e18b85df471ac9e2412dc07057020402.png[/img]
There are times where you need a weapon capable of taking out a target with a single shot from long range. That’s where the Agency steps in — they’re ready to equip you with the ultimate tool: the Barrett M82A1.
The Barrett M82A1 is a semi-automatic, large-caliber sniper rifle developed in the 1980s by the American company Barrett Firearms Manufacturing and its founder, Ronnie Barrett. Chambered in .50 BMG (12.7×99 mm) ammunition, it is known for its incredible power and an effective range of up to 1,800 meters. A single shot from the Barrett M82A1 can penetrate lightly armored vehicles, defensive structures, and other hardened targets.
Renowned for its reliability, accuracy, and sheer destructive force, the Barrett M82A1 earned the nickname "Light Fifty" and remains one of the most iconic sniper rifles in the world. It is currently in use by military and law enforcement units across many countries.
You’ll find the Barrett M82A1 - along with a wide arsenal of other weapons - waiting for you in the Multiverse of Active Matter. Register now on our website and follow us on social media so you don't miss your chance to join the closed beta and be among the first to experience the game!

notes.title: Sting Like a Scorpion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/ddc1ed0519c0e8be4eb689c2539409561364613d.jpg[/img]
Operatives! In addition to the rare weapons available across the Multiverse, the Agency also provides you with top-tier equipment.

A prime example from this arsenal is the legendary Scorpion EVO 3. This submachine gun is known for its high Czech quality; combining compact size, exceptional reliability and impressive fire rate. 

The Scorpion EVO 3 is held in high esteem by elite special forces around the world. Its rail system allows it to be customized for any tactical purposes, while the three firing modes provide exceptional flexibility in any combat situation. All this makes the Scorpion EVO 3 stand out among modern submachine guns.

Try out its outstanding combat capabilities during the next closed beta test. Register on the game’s website and follow us on social media, so you won’t miss your chance to be among the first to play Active Matter.

notes.title: Not Just AKMs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/4f63c4c3dc0706bc8f6f5a93583481cf37d1ade2.jpg[/img]
Due to different versions of the multiverse, operatives in Active Matter can sometimes come across unique weapon prototypes.
One of them is the TKB-022P experimental bullpup assault rifle, designed by Korobov and developed in the USSR in the 1960s. It stands out from other weapons not only because of its unusual appearance, but also because of its internal design. The rifle’s mechanisms are hidden under a plastic housing. The weapon’s compact size and the materials used in its construction made it lighter and easier to handle.
You can try out the TKB-022P and various other weapons in combat during the upcoming closed beta test. To make sure you don’t miss this opportunity, register on the [url=https://activematter.game/en/cbt]game’s website[/url], follow us on social media and stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: Active Matter is getting the biggest update in online shooters’ history
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/9351d09c349ecd99ceff2bf75afcad47c78db25c.jpg[/img]
Dear fighters, get your weapons ready and prepare for the most incredible adventure of your life — the universe of our game is becoming even bigger, bolder and more amazing!
[h2]40,000 worlds — one epic battle![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/d24305161d7a3671def13264cd939e157bbd8cdc.jpg[/img]
Now you can create your own clan and challenge other teams in a large-scale conquest of the multiverse of 40,000 unique realities! Fight for worlds where dinosaurs live side by side with people, where humanity thrives in an ideal utopian state, where civilization is frozen in the harsh Middle Ages or desperately fights for survival after the fall of a devastating asteroid. Now only your clan decides the fate of the worlds!
[h2]Dogtags and slavery mechanics[/h2]
Did you defeat your opponent? Now you can rip off his dogtag and take him prisoner. Just equip this tag in the next raid, and the captured operative will become your slave and will fulfill your wildest desires! Keep your enemies in fear, increase the army of captured soldiers and try not to get captured yourself.
[h2]Spectacular dance battles[/h2]
Who said that war must be won by force of arms? Challenge your opponents to a merciless dance-battle, demonstrate your best moves and prove to the entire multiverse who is the real king of the dance floor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/9a30bd856dc2634f9f627d90b5764493b0d649a3.gif[/img]
[h2]Exclusive special edition for $9999![/h2]
Only 100 of the most devoted fans will be able to receive a special edition, which includes a smartwatch with a personal AI assistant "Miss Second", always ready to support you in and out of battle. In addition, the set includes a personal dogtag with your name (or any other, of your choice). The basic edition of the game will cost only $999.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/5dbcc660ae471d7e3b1a5da469d585b10b4fedce.png[/img]

[b]The pre-order opening announcement will be published soon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/dfdbaf59a024bda12352dbe26cbb09fb8cd4e7cb.png[/img]
Prepare your weapons, gather your friends, learn your dance moves and wait for the grand update. 40,000 worlds are waiting for you to conquer them!

notes.title: The Multiverse Expands: New Operatives on Dalniy Island!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/0145d341056b9daeb367e7c9be25ac2d6f199516.jpg[/img]
Over the past two months, we've conducted several closed playtests. Participants tested their skills in classic PvPvE raids, as well as in a "last survivor" format on the Military Base, where impressive stockpiles of rare firearms are stored.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/5870db58acf800aad2ece33a483d3595c0ed4e05.jpg[/img]
Test participants were able to try out the Agency's most advanced tech in combat:

[list]
[*] Re-teleportation Beacon: A device for returning to the same multiverse variant after death. A second chance to complete contracts or take revenge.
[*] Safe Container: A container that automatically teleports collected items to the shelter in case of death. Rare remains and valuable items won't be lost.
[/list]
Furthermore, the Agency managed to locate universes where it's possible to transform into creatures altered by Active Matter. Our operatives were able to try on the skin of a hunter. In order to better fight our enemies, we need to think like them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/2c7aad2c2bee51f326b8b667f89d43782daf7e6f.jpg[/img]
According to the statistics, Shegolskoe was the most visited location by operatives. Ozernoe took second place. The Agency's intel and Miss Second’s valuable advice helped operatives complete their assigned tasks in these zones with maximum efficiency.

More than three thousand variations of Dalniy Island were visited and surveyed. One of our best operatives managed to complete 115 raids in just two days!

Thank you for your cooperation, and remember: Through rebirth, we will find the path to immortality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/04e47a9ce36b9be1b935317b87c99c6ae4487661.jpg[/img]
We would like to express our deepest gratitude to all test participants! Together, we have extensive work ahead of us in uncovering all the secrets of the Multiverse, and you are the pioneers of it!

notes.title: Picnic by the lake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/d2898ab68662273b6833d6711a47692bef5afeba.jpg[/img]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]I’m your voice assistant and chief coordinator from the Agency, Miss Second. Welcome to the briefing![/th]
        [th] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/24022a8673dd04008a3e92632ce13c20ec45ef1a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/d43d4466aa10b81f0d844c6b336401d42a3c0106.png[/img][/url][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Before you in this image is the village of Ozernoe. It was one of the first areas to experience the consequences of out-of-control experiments and thus quickly became an important location of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/9f8586a58e7eeaaa967552d109a1b2474e5fbff9.jpg[/img]
Civilian infrastructure, connected by dirt and paved roads, have become anomalous zones. Be cautious when crossing the sylvan glade. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/b1960d5d6e5c248846e4763e121e6212acbf73fa.jpg[/img]
The observation deck, power plant, and village church are located by the lakeside. According to our data, other operatives often seek to occupy sniper positions in these areas. So, if your aim is to avoid trouble, keep a close eye on windows and rooftops.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/c4c90f559073ec50460b9966fac87a96af75f160.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/8ed7fa6947d4c1bfc303f09c7c83fd73baefd792.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
The Agency doesn't know much yet about the anomalous flora and fauna in the vicinity of Ozernoe. Be sure to obtain a few samples for our research. They can be extremely valuable for the Agency, irrespective of the risks involved in acquiring such specimens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/71ed41ed1bd9733cf542a86a0a90681a5a13f755.jpg[/img]
If you're heading into the anomalous zone to look for items saturated with active matter, you should check out the fire station. After the evacuation, many items were left behind, but high competition between operatives in this area leads to frequent casualties. Fortunately, death is not an uncommon experience for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/ae836fc7c4dc1eb13182cdab4f323010f34da287.jpg[/img]
Other civilian buildings scattered throughout the area may also prove useful to you. Behind thick walls, you can lurk in ambush or find shelter in order to patch yourself up, as well as using the time to carefully map out your route.

You will receive more detailed information about your missions in this area immediately before deployment.

Remember, operative: Through rebirth, we will find the path to immortality!

notes.title: Tranquil Village Charm
notes.content:
The "Shegolskoe" village was abandoned by its people even before the cataclysm. Through some agents’ eyes, it may still look quiet and peaceful, but this first impression is deceptive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/75eff6f4ca1a130f0aa757fdada5a69d0ea81141.jpg[/img]
Operatives frequently visit the village to collect active matter while weaving between houses, front gardens and abandoned vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/d6a0f244cc95d4e7da0e9c7643d3d822e1163e9c.jpg[/img]
The water tower offers an excellent view that helps to plan a safe route or catch an unlucky scavenger in the crosshairs of a sniper rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/dc31a8cdb48f382cabb00a92ee8c1e7b6d7e3b41.jpg[/img]
Before entering any house, it's worth checking the windows to see if any threats are lurking in dark corners.

Danger can also come from above if you find yourself near a gravitational distortion; an area of space that has changed its physical properties under the influence of active matter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/d6d6bae8d18487000ef991ce3d9c5086bfd183c5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/bde58784d2b6f0a2f5a8395334668aaf0d4259e9.jpg[/img]

Small apartment complexes stand on the outskirts of the village, where the gravity there is also capable of throwing surprises at you.

When heading to Shegolskoe, be prepared to listen for rustling sounds, be watchful for what’s above, and engage in combat under unfavorable conditions. Good luck, operative!

notes.title: Operatives!
notes.content:
Happy holidays! May the next year bring you many joyful experiences, and we will do our best to create a game worthy of your expectations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/133f2f466fca8b806702caba02dc49dc4e06898d.jpg[/img]
See you soon in the quantum-unstable zones!

Best wishes,

Matter.Team

notes.title: The First Active Matter Playtest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/da26285f4589c7bf09a2c9f5e28677063f8fce3a.jpg[/img]
We’re delighted to announce the success of our first closed playtest of Active Matter!

Around 50 selected testers took part in a series of PvPvE raids for 5 hours on a variety different places across Dalniy Island - including an abandoned village, a derelict factory, strangely-colored lakes and even a scrapyard at midnight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/4f6fdb7a70d78c4007613f9f1a1d1ad821e1d5ac.jpg[/img]
Players were able to experiment with dispatching the various monsters that inhabit each region and hunt other testers for loot and glory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/a0ca58d968bb47b98a6790051604759041e3108d.jpg[/img]
We were able to collect extremely valuable feedback to improve the game - now we look forward to more upcoming waves of Closed Beta Tests where we will invite more of you to participate. We’re eager to show more of you the Multiverse!

If you are interested in participating in future tests, register your interest on our website below and you may receive an invitation. If you have already done so, keep an eye on your inbox and our social media.

[url=https://activematter.game/en/cbt]activematter.game[/url]

notes.title: Distorted Gravity
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/75bc554f35b4b73bffe7c684d25fee4580e84eb9.jpg[/img]
“Active matter” breaks the fabric of space-time, and one of its most visible effects is demonstrated by zones with altered gravity. In such a locale, operatives can veritably run on building walls, performing unusual tactical maneuvers. However, one must be prepared for attacks from the ceiling or enemies escaping along the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/ce21b01e46102cb72e50f7b920085afe6a2e2ecf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Lurking Threats
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/c716893c15bb863c85dc5613864a26da6dbe46e5.png[/img]

The main danger in the zone comes from well-equipped, experienced operatives - players just like yourselves. However, prolonged exposure to “active matter” alters the composition and structure of living creatures - this is how mutants appear in each location, losing their human appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/5c5df9520e9fe024d49861548670004b266bd4cf.jpg[/img]

Nevertheless, “active matter” not only takes away humanity and familiar appearances, inflicting suffering, but also grants incredible abilities in return.

notes.title: Welcome to Active Matter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/5632878e547686e240a95b58a74077ec549ac074.png[/img]

Introducing a new mind-bending tactical shooter set in a fractured multiverse!

Starting today, registration begins for those willing to participate in Active Matter’s Closed Beta Test!

[h1][url=https://activematter.game/en/cbt][u]Sign Up[/u][/url][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/3b7c9d9b34aaedfe8d51ae728d0055b231a58097.jpg[/img]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How will I know if I received access to the Closed Beta Test (CBT)?[/h3]

You will receive messages about CBT stages via the email linked to the Gaijin account you’ve used for the application. We will explain there how access to it will be granted. 

[h3]When will the CBT start and how long will it last?[/h3]

Information about the Closed Beta Test start date and duration will be sent to your email closer to the time.

[h3]Do I need a Gaijin account to participate?[/h3]

Yes, you will need a Gaijin account to participate in the Closed Beta Test, which you can create for free if you don't already have one.

[h3]Does applying for the Beta Test guarantee my participation?[/h3]

The application guarantees that we will inform you about the Beta Test start date and how to participate. Please note that the number of test participants is limited.

[h3]Will the Beta Test be available only on PC?[/h3]

Yes.

[h3]Why do you accept CBT application via Gaijin.Net accounts only?[/h3]

Unfortunately, other services do not allow the developers to selectively send out CBT invitations to people that expressed interest in the game, and they do not have a closed forum for discussing the game directly with developers. Therefore, we use the Gaijin.Net service, where these features are implemented.

[h3]Will there be commemorative gifts in the game for CBT participants that will be kept in the final version?[/h3]

Yes, we plan to do this.

[h3]When do you plan to start selling the full version of Active Matter and how much will it cost?[/h3]

The exact date and price haven't been determined yet, as they depend on the Closed Beta Test results among other factors.

[h3]Who is developing Active Matter?[/h3]

Matter Team is an internal studio made up of experienced developers, including veterans from Darkflow Software that worked on Enlisted and CRSED: Cuisine Royale, as well as fresh talent bringing new perspectives and ideas. Matter Team developed the latest CRSED: Cuisine Royale updates, but Active Matter is their key project right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/33f4ca464e7a58d5de157f4595488509e1150b0d.jpg[/img]

You'll play as an operative trapped in a time loop, returning to the same point after each death. You'll choose your loadout and venture into quantum-unstable zones rich with “active matter” — a substance capable of warping and ripping the very fabric of space and time. You'll face opponents from other timelines, physics-breaking anomalies, and mysterious supernatural entities. Your mission: extract active matter, collect loot, and evacuate safely before the zone ceases to exist along with everything inside it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276524/c193523a5252fa82c2bad3d3f4438c61515df4ac.jpg[/img]

Active Matter is a realistic hardcore shooter (both PvPvE and PvP modes will be available) with authentic weapons and equipment, set in a strange chaotic world inspired by SCP. Objects from other timelines can be randomly transferred by active matter into quantum-unstable zones, allowing players at their safe point base to copy items from these other timelines. Active Matter's arsenal is based on real military technology and tactics, as war seems to be the only constant across the multiverse.
In the coming weeks and months, we'll be sharing more details about Active Matter's weapons, enemies, and locations. Meanwhile, you can sign up for the Closed Beta Test, which will begin soon, before the end of 2024.
